# Somatiq

> Intelligent RIS-PACS platform for radiology. One unified platform for your entire diagnostic imaging workflow.

## Company Overview

Somatiq is a healthcare technology company building modern radiology infrastructure for India. Founded by radiologists and engineers, we provide an AI-first RIS-PACS (Radiology Information System and Picture Archiving and Communication System) platform that unifies the entire diagnostic imaging workflow.

## What We Do

- **Unified RIS-PACS Platform**: Single intelligent platform from patient registration to final report
- **Teleradiology Services**: 24/7 expert reporting with subspecialty radiologists
- **AI-Powered Workflows**: Native intelligence built into every feature, not bolted on
- **Modern User Experience**: Consumer-grade UX designed for radiologists

## Key Differentiators

- AI-first architecture (not retrofitted)
- 10x faster deployment (days, not months)
- Built by radiologists who understand clinical workflows
- Part of NVIDIA Inception program
- Live and commercialized across 10+ diagnostic centres in India

## Target Users

- Diagnostic imaging centres
- Hospitals with radiology departments
- Radiology practices
- Healthcare providers seeking teleradiology services

## Location

Bengaluru, India

## Technical Details

- Cloud-native platform
- DICOM compliant
- HL7/FHIR integration capable
- Web-based viewer
- Mobile responsive
